podcast.title: Emotional Hip Hop Themes
podcast.body: Emo Rap fuses the thematic elements and emotional depth of Emo with hip hop, resulting in highly personal and vulnerable lyrical content that explores themes like heartbreak, fear, anxiety, depression, and loneliness. "Basically, we get all of Emo's hits when it comes to themes and feels, made it with hip hop, very personal, very vulnerable stuff, heartbreak, fear, anxiety, depression, loneliness."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: The History of the 2010s Part 3: The New Genres

podcast.title: Offshoot of Emo
podcast.body: Emo Rap is described as a combination of emo and hip hop, starting to appear at the end of the 2000s decade. Its name directly reflects its blended sound. "There was Emo Wrap, which is just like it sounds, a combination of emo and hip hop. It started popping up at the end of the decade."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: SoundCloud Birthplace
podcast.body: Emo Rap primarily originated and gained prominence on SoundCloud, serving as a key platform for its development and dissemination. "This genre was birthed on SoundCloud more than anywhere else."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: The History of the 2010s Part 3: The New Genres
